Data center business expansion will take 18 to 24 months before revenues commence once contracts are finalized.
BFSI grew 2.5% sequentially in constant currency, while Manufacturing and Technology & Services each grew 3.1%.

operating_notes.text: TCS signed MoUs with Siemens Energy AG and Siemens Energy India Limited covering IT services, industrial AI, and HyperVault data center energy support.
TCS successfully went live with Release 1 of ASX's CHESS program using TCS BaNCS and Quartz solutions, with Release 2 targeted for 2029.
TCS forged a global strategic partnership with Rezolve Ai to enter the agentic AI commerce market.
TCS launched SovereignSecure Cloud in Europe for governments and regulated industries.
TCS announced a global AI-led business transformation contract win from SKF.
TCS partnered with Mistral to become the first Global Systems Integrator to bring Mistral Forge to enterprises worldwide.
Moody's upgraded TCS's long-term local currency issuer rating from Baa1 to A2.
TCS expanded its partnership with Euroclear to deploy TCS BaNCS and Quartz for modernizing Sweden's central securities depository as part of the 'One Nordic' vision.
TCS secured an AI-led IT transformation and application management contract from Finland-based Nokian Tyres.
TCS signed a multiyear AI-powered IT transformation and managed services agreement with Canada Life across Europe.
TCS launched the Global Value & Innovation Centres (GVIC) Business Unit to help enterprises build AI-native GCCs, appointing Soumen Roy as its Head.

Q1FY27 TCV was US$9.5 billion, including a US$800 million net-new mega deal with SKF (sixth mega deal in five quarters), a multi-million-dollar ServiceNow partnership and a multi-million-dollar deal with a Europe-based Fortune Global 50 fir

AI services annualised revenue was US$2.6 billion, up 13.6% QoQ, with an incremental add of US$75 million versus US$125 million in the March quarter; management says AI projects are one- to two-quarter, non-annuity work.
Productivity gains passed to clients are around 10%-15% on average, front-loaded and smoothed over the project term, per management.
Total headcount reached 598,056 associates in Q2FY27.
DSO stood at 74 days, holding constant sequentially in dollar terms.
Industrial Intelligence Foundry launched on October 15, 2026, targeting 20-25% productivity gains.
TCS deploying BaNCS for Treasury at Indian Bank's Colombo branch in Sri Lanka

timeline.summary: TCS signed two Memorandums of Understanding with Siemens Energy AG and Siemens Energy India Limited for a strategic AI partnership and data center energy support.
TCS announced the successful go-live of Release 1 of the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) CHESS program for cash clearing and settlement.
Tata Consultancy Services Limited’s Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 9, 2026, with Record Date for final dividend set to May 25, 2026, and dividend payment on June 12, 2026.
TCS announced a global strategic partnership with Rezolve Ai to enter the agentic commerce market.
TCS launched SovereignSecure Cloud in Europe to provide secure and compliant cloud architectures for enterprises and governments.
TCS secured a global AI-led business transformation contract from SKF.
TCS announced a strategic partnership with Mistral, becoming the first global systems integrator partner for Mistral Forge.
TCS clarified that media reports regarding losing part of the Royal Bank of Canada technology mandate are completely false.
Moody's upgraded TCS's long-term local currency issuer rating from Baa1 to A2 following an update to its sovereign linkages methodology.
TCS expanded its partnership with Euroclear to modernize Sweden's central securities depository using TCS BaNCS and Quartz.
TCS secured an AI-led IT transformation contract from Finland-based Nokian Tyres.
TCS signed a multiyear AI-powered IT transformation and managed services agreement with Canada Life across Europe.
2026-06-08: TCS launched the Global Value & Innovation Centres (GVIC) Business Unit to help enterprises build AI-native GCCs, appointing Soumen Roy as its Head.
TCS reported Q2FY27 constant currency growth of 2.8% YoY with 24% EBIT margin, TCV of $9.6B, and annualized AI revenues reaching $3.1B.
TCS launched the Industrial Intelligence Foundry to accelerate AI-led autonomy in engineering and manufacturing.
2026-10-15: TCS completed the acquisition of 100% partnership interest in BBY Services India LLP, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
TCS expands BaNCS treasury platform to Sri Lanka with Indian Bank

watchlist.response: Krithivasan said it is difficult to quantify; gave a rule-of-thumb 10%-15% productivity gain, offset by additional work from clients
watchlist.text: Yogesh Aggarwal asked what share of business has already passed AI productivity gains to clients

watchlist.response: Attributed to lumpy one- to two-quarter project nature; no quantification of the trend
watchlist.text: Sudheer Guntupalli asked whether the fall in incremental AI revenue ($75 mn vs $125 mn prior quarter) reflects seasonality or conflict impact

watchlist.response: Evasive: "I don't know whether I can put a rate of change or quantify that at this time"
watchlist.text: Sudheer Guntupalli pressed for the rate of change in demand improvement

watchlist.response: Samir Seksaria said the COR/SG&A split was discontinued; cited talent, partnerships and M&A charges without figures
watchlist.text: Kumar Rakesh asked for granularity on the 16% YoY rise in SG&A investments

watchlist.response: Attributed mainly to the 170 bps wage impact plus vertical-specific investments
watchlist.text: Ashwin Mehta asked why segmental margins fell 250-300 bps across manufacturing, communications and life sciences

watchlist.response: Krithivasan said no such massive contraction is visible and headcount rose
watchlist.text: Abhishek Shindadkar asked how the 10%-15% productivity gain reconciles with forecasts of a $300 bn compression in $1 trillion tech spend

watchlist.response: Samir Seksaria explained that higher subcontracting and bench capacity was proactively hired to fulfill demand in next-gen skills, which will yield operating leverage with a lag.
watchlist.text: Gross margin declined sequentially despite absence of wage hikes, driven by surging subcontractor and delivery costs.
